purpose: Use local visual AI where it improves attention without weakening source truth, while reserving Codex generation for important support assets.
global_rule: AI can illustrate, relight, extend, or reconstruct. It cannot prove. Deterministic motion on real evidence is preferred to generative motion.

thumbnail_key_art.use: important non-proof hero support, relighting, background extension, atmosphere, cutouts, and composition support
thumbnail_key_art.gate: owner-approved scope and exact source-truth boundary

thumbnail_key_art.use: local non-proof support variations and edits
thumbnail_key_art.gate: model and companion-file hashes plus a current local benchmark must pass
local endpoint, model identity, workflow hash, and benchmark must pass

routine_nonproof_stills.strength: fast local concept and atmosphere generation

source_still_motion.use: Ken Burns, focus crop, source highlight, map trace, document closeup, split comparison, and subtle 2.5D parallax
short restrained atmospheric movement when deterministic motion is insufficient
source_still_motion.commercial_boundary: royalty-free direct use below USD 10,000,000 annual entity revenue; a separate paid commercial license is required at or above that threshold

source_still_motion.use: premium local 3-5 second image-to-video support clip

allowed_without_reconstruction_label: depth-separated parallax that preserves people and architecture
dust, film grain, light, and restrained atmospheric particles
source highlights, arrows, labels, and map paths
restoration, stabilization, denoise, and upscale that do not change meaning
requires_reconstruction_label_and_owner_: generated facial expression, blinking, lip motion, or speech
new camera angle or geometry that did not exist in the source
realistic footage of a real place or event that was never captured
blocked: motion that changes the source meaning
AI output used as historical evidence
